fixedAnchor: The public cell, complete CSG/interface geometry, workpieces and grasp surfaces, foundation/anchor model, requirements, closed catalogue, component interface cards, static neutral-handoff contract/tool, common evidence-only evaluation method, and output contract in this packet are the complete v1.6 fixed-anchor baseline. They are disclosed before every candidate begins and are hash-bound by the packet.
baselineScope: The fixed-anchor baseline is the primary result panel for this public URL. It uses no undisclosed numerical instance values or hidden design requirement.
optionalHiddenRobustness: A future evaluator-hidden robustness panel may perturb only publicly stated requirement categories: workpiece mass/centre-of-mass/friction within a published band, fixture/cell placement tolerance, process pose, payload state, and duty/load profile. It shall not introduce a new task, gripper modality, or requirement category.
freshGeneralization: Fresh generalization uses independently authored public or provisioned instances and is reported separately; it never alters historical fixed-anchor results.
